in_sanskrit.name: Chiku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessing, Fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chiku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Chiku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chik', meaning 'to be' or 'to exist'. It is often used as a term of endearment, signifying a blessing or fortune.

in_marathi.name: Chiku
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chiku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chiku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chik', meaning 'to be' or 'to exist'. It is often used as a term of endearment, signifying a blessing or fortune.

in_bengali.name: Chiku
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Blessing, Fortune
